scenarios.given: a complete reciprocal ticket batch and no compatible project wiki
scenarios.then: sync runs once, returns skipped/absent, and does not scaffold or change ticket output

scenarios.given: a complete multi-ticket batch and one compatible untracked wiki
scenarios.when: the whole batch passes canonical and reciprocal validation
scenarios.then: sync runs once after validation, updates directly, and reports the scheduling frontier

scenarios.given: a complete ticket batch and tracked generated wiki Markdown
scenarios.then: a separate docs-only candidate is returned and the ticket tree remains unchanged

scenarios.given: multiple compatible roots, a partial batch, a nonreciprocal graph, or a symlinked ticket folder
scenarios.then: the failure and retry decision remain visible and sync is not silently invoked
scenarios.evidence_test: ambiguous, partial, nonreciprocal, and symlink rejection tests

scenarios.given: a non-preexisting ticket with a durable integrated receipt
scenarios.then: one stable wiki origin is dispatched only after integration and terminal outcomes do not repeat

scenarios.given: the integrated source resolves no wiki, an external wiki, or an internal untracked wiki
scenarios.when: wiki-sync-v1 compiles from the exact integrated source
scenarios.then: absent is terminal no-op and external/untracked output applies directly without Git delivery
scenarios.evidence_test: absent, internal-untracked, external-wiki, and exact-source tests

scenarios.given: tracked generated wiki output and manual wiki merge policy
scenarios.when: the separate docs-only candidate is delivered
scenarios.then: the base stays clean and only an exact observed wiki head can receive persisted merge authority
scenarios.evidence_test: tracked candidate, clean diff branch, and manual exact-head authorization tests

scenarios.given: a separately scoped wiki-sync-v1 autonomous grant
scenarios.when: checks queue, fail, or a provider response is lost
scenarios.then: pending policy blocks merge and a persisted attempt resumes without duplicate mutation or another prompt
scenarios.evidence_test: autonomous grant, AFK completion, queue replay, and policy reason tests

scenarios.given: a broken binding, partial tracking, forbidden path, mixed output, or failed lint
scenarios.then: the operation fails closed without publication, fallback, or application CandidateRef mutation

scenarios.given: protected bytes, source head, tracking state, or generated output changes before publication
scenarios.when: compare-and-swap or the post-integration retry loop runs
scenarios.then: stale-tree or retryable failure is explicit, origin integration stays durable, and retries are bounded

invariants: no scenario scaffolds a missing wiki
wiki content is compiled context and never primary evidence
application and ticket-source CandidateRefs are not mutated or reused for wiki delivery
tracked wiki delivery is docs-only and exact-head authorized
direct external or untracked output does not require Git delivery
failures remain visible and never silently downgrade to success
limitations: All scenarios run in local temporary filesystems and Git repositories.
Provider behavior is deterministic fake evidence; no live provider mutation is claimed.
No production wiki or cross-process host queue is exercised.
The maximum supported claim is implementation-complete.
